title: Cigar-shaped craft near Turtle Mountain
place_text: Turtle Mountain, on the road from Cuba, New Mexico

tellings.quote: but there was this, it looked like a cigar.

plain: A cigar-shaped object was seen near Turtle Mountain, on the road from Cuba, New Mexico, according to a woman named Christa, who tells Michels she saw it herself. "It looked like a cigar," she says. She also brings a United Airlines pilot into her account, and if she is right, a strange craft was flying over that stretch of New Mexico road.
